name: api-automation
description: Postman API automation run with Newman

scripts.test: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:practice
scripts.test:practice: newman run collections/practice/practice-api-testing-demo.postman_collection.json -e environments/jsonplaceholder.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title 'API Automation Report' --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle 'API Automation Report'
